claim.claim-text: 1. A storage bag for a defibrillator, the storage bag being openable and closable, configured to couple to a portion of the defibrillator, and comprising:

an interior configured to store an accessory of the defibrillator; and an opening defined in a portion of the storage bag, the opening configured to allow the accessory to be coupled to the defibrillator while the accessory is stored within the interior of the storage bag and while the storage bag is closed.
2. The storage bag of claim 1, wherein:
3. The storage bag of claim 2, wherein:

4. The storage bag of claim 1, 2 or 3, wherein the opening defined in the portion of the storage bag is aligned with a port disposed on the defibrillator when the storage bag is coupled to the portion of the defibrillator.
5. The storage bag of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein:
the storage bag comprises a side storage bag; and the portion of the defibrillator comprises a side of the defibrillator disposed between a front of the defibrillator and a back of the defibrillator.
6. The storage bag of claim 5, wherein:

the portion of the storage bag in which the opening is defined is a front cover of the storage bag; and the opening is configured to allow a cable of the accessory to pass from the interior of the storage bag through the front cover to couple the accessory to the defibrillator.
a port disposed on an exterior surface of the defibrillator and configured to receive a connector of an accessory of the defibrillator; and a storage bag according to any one of claims 1-6.

the storage bag is the side storage bag according to claim 5 or 6; and the defibrillator comprises: a port guard positioned about the port, and wherein, when the storage bag is coupled to the side of the defibrillator, the port guard is disposed within the opening defined in the portion of the storage bag; and extends into the interior of the storage bag.
a display disposed on a front of the defibrillator; and a storage bag according to any one of claims 1-6.

the storage bag is the side storage bag according to claim 5 or 6; and the defibrillator comprises: a port guard positioned about a port disposed on the defibrillator, and wherein, when the storage bag is coupled to the side of the defibrillator, the port guard: is disposed within the opening defined in the portion of the storage bag; and extends into the interior of the storage bag.
